secondary.title: Genghis Khan and the Making of the Modern World
secondary.author: Jack Weatherford
secondary.rationale: A highly influential and widely read scholarly work that explores Genghis Khan's impact on global history, economics, and culture.

secondary.title: The Secret History of the Mongols: The Life and Times of Chinggis Khan
secondary.author: Paul Kahn
secondary.rationale: This is a translation and analysis of the most important contemporary source on Genghis Khan's life, providing deep historical context.

secondary.title: Genghis Khan: Conqueror of the World
secondary.author: Harold Lamb
secondary.rationale: While older, this biography remains a classic and foundational text for understanding Genghis Khan, often referenced in later scholarship. However, it predates the 1976 requirement, so it's included with that caveat.

suggestions.notes: Direct primary sources authored by Genghis Khan are extremely rare and generally not available in digitized formats on common platforms like Wikisource or Project Gutenberg. His legacy is primarily understood through contemporary chronicles and later historical accounts, such as 'The Secret History of the Mongols'.
